answer: Each identity keeps a challenge chain: each epoch it files a sonnet hashing to the prior link, umber-stamped. A comet pass calls the next link; a wrong or missing link breaks it and burns the bond. Filing 38, the k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A rented chain fails: its sonnets never match the live challenge; auditors replay the chain in public. Honest agents file once, pay 38, keep the chain.
